title: A UI test that proves a list comes from the API must not pass on a fallback or a preloaded store
rule: When a test claims a picker or list shows what an API call returns (list_layouts, list_collections), assert an entry only that call returns (a mock file that is not a preset, a broken entry, a user copy), never only names the component's hard-coded fallback also has. Reach the view on a path where no other view loaded the shared Pinia store first (open it by URL from a mode that does not load the list), so removing the view's own load call makes the test fail. Check it once by removing the load call.
rationale: E24.1 (#156): the Pairing Studio picker test asserted Book/Columns/Quote, which the preset fallback also supplies, after Layout mode had already loaded the list into the shared store; removing the studio's loadList() still passed.
